description: Complete Netflix-style mobile app redesign. Rebuild all React Native components and screens to match the web Netflix aesthetic with mobile-native ergonomics. Use the same color tokens (#141414 bg, #E50914 primary red, white text) and design language but adapted for touch interaction, ScrollView-based rails, and native navigation patterns.
steps: Create `apps/mobile/src/theme.js` - a shared design tokens file exporting colors (background: '#141414', backgroundElevated: '#1a1a1a', card: '#181818', primary: '#E50914', primaryHover: '#F40612', text: '#FFFFFF', textMuted: '#808080', textSecondary: '#b3b3b3', border: '#333333', rating: '#46d369', overlay: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)'), spacing, borderRadius, and typography constants. This serves as the single source of truth for all mobile styling.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/_layout.jsx` - update Stack screenOptions contentStyle backgroundColor to '#141414', keep existing QueryClient, SafeAreaProvider, font loading, and SplashScreen logic.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.jsx` - Netflix-style bottom tab bar: backgroundColor '#141414', borderTopColor '#333333', activeTintColor '#FFFFFF' (Netflix uses white active), inactiveTintColor '#808080'. Keep same tab screens (home, movies, tv, search).
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/TVFocusable.jsx` - update focus border color from #2563EB to #E50914 (Netflix red), keep existing focus/scale behavior.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/ContentCard.jsx` - Netflix poster card for mobile: just the poster image filling the card (aspect ratio 2:3), rounded corners 4-6px (Netflix uses subtle rounding), no info section below by default (title only shows as a single line below poster in small text). Progress bar if watchProgress exists uses Netflix red. Pressed state dims slightly. Remove genre pills from card (keep it minimal like Netflix mobile).

Create `apps/mobile/src/components/ContentRail.jsx` - a mobile horizontal rail component: section title (bold white, 16-18px), optional See All button, horizontal ScrollView of ContentCard items (card width ~110px on phone, ~140px on tablet). Items have small gap (8-10px). Import from theme.js for colors.

Create `apps/mobile/src/components/HeroBanner.jsx` for mobile - a featured content banner: backdrop image filling ~55% of screen height, gradient from transparent to #141414 at bottom, title text large and bold at bottom-left, genre text below title, two buttons (Play: white bg black text, My List: transparent with white border). Random featured item from trending data.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/ContentGrid.jsx` - keep FlatList grid layout with numColumns logic but update styling: card background transparent (just posters), gap/padding using theme tokens, container backgroundColor '#141414'.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/DetailHero.jsx` - cinematic mobile detail: backdrop image at top ~40% of screen with gradient overlay fading to #141414, poster overlapping at bottom-left of backdrop area, title bold white to the right/below poster, metadata row (year, rating with green #46d369 text, runtime), genre row with small pills, overview text in muted color (up to 4 lines), Play button large and prominent (white bg, black text, full width or near-full width). Use theme.js colors.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/EpisodeList.jsx` - Netflix mobile episode list: season selector as a pressable dropdown-style button, each episode row shows episode number + title + runtime on one line, overview below in smaller muted text, thumbnail on left if available. Play icon on tap. Dark dividers between episodes. Use theme.js colors.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/TabBar.jsx` - Netflix category tabs for browse pages: horizontal scroll, active tab white text with red underline, inactive gray text. Match web TabNavigation styling philosophy. Use theme.js colors.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/SearchBar.jsx` - dark input field with subtle border (#333), search icon on left, clear X on right, placeholder text in muted gray. Match Netflix search UX. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/LoadingState.jsx` - Netflix-dark skeleton loaders: dark gray animated placeholders matching card/detail dimensions. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/ErrorState.jsx` - centered error with Netflix-red retry button. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/components/VideoPlayer.jsx` - update styling to use dark theme (#141414 background, white text). Keep existing WebView embed functionality intact.

Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/home.jsx` - Netflix mobile home: 1) HeroBanner featuring a trending item at top, 2) ContentRail for 'Continue Watching' (if items exist), 3) ContentRail for 'Trending Movies', 4) ContentRail for 'Trending TV Shows'. Wrapped in a ScrollView/FlatList. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/movies.jsx` - TabBar at top for category filter, ContentGrid below. Keep existing useInfiniteQuery logic. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/tv.jsx` - same pattern as movies.jsx. Keep existing query logic. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/search.jsx` - dark search page with SearchBar and ContentGrid for results. Keep existing query logic. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/movie/[id].jsx` - use new DetailHero, keep existing query logic and play navigation. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/tv/[id].jsx` - use new DetailHero + new EpisodeList, keep existing query and play logic. Use theme.js colors.
Rewrite `apps/mobile/src/app/player.jsx` - use new VideoPlayer styling, keep all embed URL logic and params handling.
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && bun run lint` and fix any lint errors until 0 remain
acceptance_criteria: apps/mobile/src/theme.js exists with Netflix color tokens, spacing, and typography constants
All mobile components import and use colors from theme.js (no more hardcoded blue #2563EB)
Tab bar uses Netflix palette: #141414 background, white active, gray inactive
Home screen has a HeroBanner at top followed by horizontal ContentRails
ContentCard is minimal poster-focused (no genre pills on card, just poster + title)
DetailHero has cinematic backdrop with gradient overlay and prominent Play button
Color scheme across all screens: #141414 background, #E50914 primary, #FFFFFF text, #333333 borders
All TMDB data fetching, watch progress, and navigation logic preserved exactly
TVFocusable focus color is Netflix red #E50914
bun run lint passes with 0 errors
findings: All verification passed: lint 0 errors and 0 warnings. Created theme.js with Netflix color tokens, HeroBanner and ContentRail as new components. Rewrote all existing components and screens to use theme.js colors (primary #E50914, background #141414, text #FFFFFF, border #333333). TVFocusable focus color updated from blue #2563EB to Netflix red #E50914. All TMDB API integration, watch progress logic, and navigation preserved exactly. Used multiple View layers with increasing opacity for gradient overlay effects on HeroBanner and DetailHero since expo-linear-gradient is not available.
